scientific_limitations: The complete three-phase classification is for v0=2, v1=1, gamma0=gamma1=1 and g=3u, with u>0.
The no-trimodality result for 0<=g<=u assumes v0>v1>0, gamma0>=gamma1>0 and u>0.
No theorem is asserted for finite-time distributions, translational diffusion, interactions or complete general-parameter modality.
title: A sharp unimodal–trimodal–bimodal transition in a two-state run-and-tumble particle
